byok.storage: Caller-origin browser localStorage only. A visitor key is never placed in this manifest, the network definition, prompts, or any peer request.

llm.note: The published network runs a deterministic tool path (public JSON-RPC reads + rule-based classification) that needs no LLM and no key. An LLM is optional narration only.

networks.description: Ask the watchdog about the latest large-transfer activity: a chain reader fetches live on-chain state, an interpreter classifies it, and the front agent answers with verifiable numbers.
networks.name: sentinel_watchdog

runtime.profile: Worldwide Agentic Web MVP Profile 0.2 (subset, see runtime.json)

brand.name: Sentinel Watchdog
brand.tagline: A watchdog for large cross-chain transfers, published as an open agent network.

site.description: An open agentic watchdog that monitors large WETH transfers on Base Sepolia and raises cross-chain alerts through the Reactive Network. The on-chain agents run autonomously; this site publishes their network so any conforming browser runtime can inspect, load, and call it.
site.name: Sentinel Watchdog
